description: A Cardputer Zero music player with MyGo Music plugin support

store.summary: Local music and streaming services, plugin-powered.
store.description: Zero Music plays local files and, with third-party MyGo Music-compatible plugins, streaming sources on Cardputer Zero. It ships no music catalogue or service credentials. The keyboard-first LVGL interface is built for the 320x170 screen.

zh-CN.summary: 本地音乐与流媒体插件播放器
zh-CN.description: Zero Music 在 Cardputer Zero 上播放本地音乐，并通过第三方 MyGo Music 兼容插件接入流媒体源。软件不附带任何音乐目录或服务凭据，界面为 320×170 屏幕和键盘操作设计。
